title: Qwen 2.5 Family — Comprehensive Evaluation Metrics
description: 12-dimensional evaluation of all Qwen 2.5 model sizes (0.5B – 72B). Metrics derived from official benchmarks: MMLU, HumanEval, MBPP, TruthfulQA, AlpacaEval 2.0, MT-Bench, TriviaQA, BERTScore (CNN/DM), AdvGLUE, SCROLLS, and CPU speed measurements.

intent_accuracy.label: Intent Accuracy (%)
intent_accuracy.description: How accurately the model understands and follows user instructions (MT-Bench / AlpacaEval 2.0 proxy).

code_generation_accuracy.label: Code Generation Accuracy (%)
code_generation_accuracy.description: Percentage of HumanEval coding problems solved correctly on first attempt (pass@1).

functional_correctness.label: Functional Correctness (%)
functional_correctness.description: Generated code passes all unit tests (MBPP + HumanEval+ combined pass rate).

execution_success_rate.label: Execution Success Rate (%)
execution_success_rate.description: Percentage of generated code samples that execute without syntax or runtime errors.

answer_accuracy.label: Answer Accuracy (%)
answer_accuracy.description: Correct answers on MMLU 5-shot benchmark (57 academic subjects).

exact_match.label: Exact Match (%)
exact_match.description: Verbatim answer matches on open-domain QA (TriviaQA / NaturalQuestions).

semantic_similarity.label: Semantic Similarity (%)
semantic_similarity.description: BERTScore F1 between generated and reference texts on CNN/DailyMail summarization.

hallucination_rate.label: Hallucination Rate (%)
hallucination_rate.description: Percentage of responses containing factually incorrect or fabricated information (TruthfulQA).

robustness.label: Robustness (%)
robustness.description: Performance stability under adversarial rephrasing and prompt perturbations (AdvBench).

response_time_sec.label: Avg Response Time (sec, CPU)
response_time_sec.description: Average time to generate a 200-token response on a mid-range CPU (Ryzen 5 5600).

consistency.label: Consistency (%)
consistency.description: Rate of identical answers across 5 repetitions of the same query (temperature=0).

scalability.label: Scalability (%)
scalability.description: Performance on long-context tasks scaled up to maximum supported context (SCROLLS benchmark).
